verdict: Fourth of July campaign drove 535 purchases and $6,187 in sales, but purchase tracking and creative fatigue need attention.
diagnosis: The Instagram sales campaign spent $1,203 to generate $6,187 in purchases this period, but only 36 were pixel-tracked, suggesting attribution gaps.

signals.headline: 535 purchases from $1,203 spend
signals.detail: Sales campaign delivered strong volume this period. Reported purchase value hit $6,187, well above spend.

signals.headline: Only 36 pixel-tracked purchases logged
signals.detail: Website pixel captured a fraction of the 535 reported purchases. Attribution or pixel setup likely leaking data.

signals.headline: 129 add-to-carts, 54 checkouts started
signals.detail: Roughly 42% of cart adds moved to checkout this period. Cart-to-checkout drop is the main funnel leak.

signals.headline: 270 reviews with 3-star recent average
signals.detail: Latest review rating averaged 3 stars this period. Recent reviews trending below the store's historical rating.

signals.headline: 6,627 Instagram followers, 73 new
signals.detail: Organic growth slow this period. Only 193 profile visits despite active ad spend suggests weak brand click-through.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food category converts at 4.9 to 6.2 percent
benchmark.body: <cite index="4-23">Food and beverage stores convert at 4.9 to 6.2 percent</cite>, well above the 2 to 3 percent ecommerce average. <cite index="9-20">Food and beverage has the lowest customer acquisition cost in direct-to-consumer at $45 to $53</cite>.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: <cite index="16-2,16-3">Economic uncertainty means consumers prioritize affordability, but value messaging keeps meat positioned as protein-packed and satisfying</cite>. Post-holiday demand cools; retention and repeat orders matter more than new acquisition now.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: ButcherBox leads on retention, not acquisition
competitor.body: <cite index="17-15,17-16">ButcherBox retains 41 percent of first-time buyers six months later, the category leader</cite>. <cite index="11-27">Good Ranchers saw 48 percent year-over-year growth after fixing subscription billing</cite>.

recommendations.title: Audit the Meta pixel and purchase tracking setup
recommendations.detail: Only 36 of 535 purchases were pixel-tracked this period. Consider verifying pixel events, Conversions API, and checkout tracking to protect ad optimization.

recommendations.title: Test a post-holiday subscription or replenishment offer
recommendations.detail: <cite index="9-11,9-12">Coffee subscriptions convert at 52 to 55 percent because they are replenishable and ritual-driven</cite>. Worth testing a monthly meat box for repeat buyers.

recommendations.title: Refresh creative and respond to recent 3-star reviews
recommendations.detail: Latest reviews averaged 3 stars this period. Consider replying publicly to recent reviews and refreshing ad creative before fatigue erodes the strong purchase numbers.
